description: Points a domain at a project hosted on forkrail.com: a CNAME to <project>.forkrail.com, and optionally the _acme-challenge CNAME that lets forkrail get the domain's certificate before traffic moves (required for wildcards). Applied with host for a subdomain, or without host at the root on DNS providers that flatten a root CNAME.
variableDescription: %project%: the project's name, one DNS label (my-app points the domain at my-app.forkrail.com). %acme%: 16 lowercase hex characters naming the domain's challenge record, the first 8 bytes of sha256('forkrail-acme:' + the domain).
